name: OutreachAgent
description: Runs reply-aware cold outbound email for AI agents with managed inboxes, durable sequences, signed webhooks, sender pacing, approvals, and delivery observability.

skills.name: Manage Inboxes
skills.description: Provision and manage sending inboxes programmatically so agent runtimes can operate dedicated email identities without manual mailbox setup.

skills.name: Run Reply-Aware Sequences
skills.description: Run durable multi-step sequences with waits, retries, branching, reply exit criteria, simulations, previews, and test sends.

skills.name: Route Reply Events
skills.description: Route inbound replies and delivery events to agent runtimes through signed webhooks with retries and replayable delivery logs.

skills.name: Enforce Sending Guardrails
skills.description: Enforce per-inbox send limits, approval policies, suppression rules, and automatic pauses when bounce or complaint thresholds rise.

skills.name: Observe Outbound Execution
skills.description: Inspect thread history, workflow execution logs, delivery metrics, and audit logs before the runtime chooses the next action.

skills.name: Manage Outreach Resources
skills.description: Manage contacts, templates, domains, and bulk enrollments through the REST API or the published TypeScript SDK.
